install.heading: Software Update Preparation
items: The software version update data is first saved to an SD card or CFexpress Type A memory card . \t Note: “CFexpress Type A memory card” is referred to as “CFexpress card(s)” in this document.
The camera is then updated using the screen menu. \t Note: Refer to the camera's Operating Instructions for details on how to use the menu.

install.heading: Checking the Current Software Version
items: Select Version .
Select Version Number in the Maintenance menu.

install.heading: Notes About Updating
items: When updating the software, always connect the supplied AC adaptor to the camera. If a battery pack is attached at the same time, the update will continue even if the AC adaptor is subsequently disconnected.
Remove any connected devices (such as USB devices, SDI/HDMI cables, microphones, and shoe mount accessories), and eject any media cards that are not necessary for the update.
When using an SD card, use an SDXC memory card.

Use an SDXC or CFexpress card that has been formatted in the memory card slot using the camera's formatting function. \t Note: Refer to the camera's Operating Instructions for details about the formatting function and supported SDXC / CFexpress cards.

install.heading: Saving the Software Version Update Data to an SDXC Card or CFexpress Card
items: Connect the formatted SDXC or CFexpress card to a computer.
Download the software version update data from the download page, then save the data file to your computer.
Save the data file in the root directory of the SDXC or CFexpress card. Do not change the file name.

install.heading: Before you start
items: Do not perform any of the following actions while updating the system software. Doing so could cause the update to fail and the camera to stop working:\n\n\t
Turning the camera off
Refer to the camera's Operating Instructions for more information.

install.heading: How to update the system software version
items: Insert the SDXC or CFexpress card that contains the saved software version update data into slot B of the camera. \t Note: Only slot B will recognize the software version update data.
Select Version .
Select Version Up in the Maintenance menu. \t Note: The Version Up option cannot be selected if the software version update data cannot be found.
Select Execute . \t Note: After performing this step, a “Please use the AC Adaptor” message will appear.

Select Execute on the software version update confirmation screen. \t Note: After performing this step, a “Version Update VX.XX > VY.YY” message will appear. \t( X.XX : current version number; Y.YY : newest version number)
Select Execute on the software version update confirmation screen again.\n\t
When the software version update is successfully completed, the access indicator will stop flashing, and the unit will restart automatically.

Check that the software version has been updated (refer to the Checking the Current Software Version section of this document for details). \t Note: If the system software has not been updated to the latest version, check the version update procedure, and then perform the update procedure again from step 1 .
Set the camera power switch to OFF , disconnect and reconnect the power cord, and then set the power switch to ON .
Check the software version update procedure, then perform the update procedure again from step 1 .
If the issue persists and the update is not successful, there may be a problem with the camera. In this case, please contact a Sony service representative for further assistance.

summary: Software Update Package 6.1.1 is a compatibility and reliability update.

install.heading: Update Procedure
items: After downloading the update file from the Software Update Packages for Cameras webpage, double-click the downloaded .zip file to unpack it, or unpack it manually. This will extract two update files to your computer (*.SWU and *.lic)
If not done beforehand, prepare the USB-C medium for use with the ARRI ALEXA 265 by connecting it to the Remote and push CONFIRM. This will create the required folder structure on the USB-C medium
Connect the USB-C medium to your computer. Place the downloaded *.swu file in the ARRI/ALEXA265/SUP folder. Place the downloaded *.lic file in the ARRI/ALEXA265/LICENSES folder

The camera Software Update Package includes updates not only for the camera body but also for the MVF-2 viewfinder and the lens mount. Therefore, ensure that the MVF-2 viewfinder and the lens mount are connected to the camera during the update process
Ensure the camera is connected to a power supply or powered by a fully charged battery to prevent power loss during the update
Connect the USB-C medium to the camera and navigate to the menu item
Ensure that the correct time zone is set in MENU > System > System Time & Date

summary: We are pleased to introduce Software Update Package SUP 6.1.0. for all camera models in the ALEXA 35 family: ALEXA 35, ALEXA 35 Xtreme, ALEXA 35 Live, and ALEXA 35 Live Xtreme. items: After downloading the update file from the Software Update Packages for Cameras webpage, double-click the downloaded .zip file to unpack it, or unpack it manually. This will extract two update files to your computer (*.SWU and *.lic)
If not done beforehand, prepare the USB-C medium for use with the ARRI ALEXA camera by connecting it to Remote and push CONFIRM. This will create the required folder structure on the USB-C medium

Connect the USB-C medium to your computer. Place the downloaded *.swu file in the ARRI/ALEXA35/SUP folder. Place the downloaded *.lic file in the ARRI/ALEXA35/LICENSES folder. Place the downloaded *.swu file in the ARRI/ALEXA265/SUP folder. Place the downloaded *.lic file in the ARRI/ALEXA265/LICENSES folder

The camera Software Update Package includes updates not only for the camera body but also for the MVF-2 viewfinder and the lens mount. Therefore, ensure that the MVF-2 viewfinder and the lens mount are connected to the camera during the update process
Ensure the camera is connected to a power supply or powered by a fully charged battery to prevent power loss during the update. ALEXA Series, Software Update Package 6.1.0
Connect the USB-C medium to the camera and navigate to the menu item

To downdate an ALEXA 265 to SUP 3.0.3, you shall first downdate to SUP 3.0.4 and then from SUP 3.0.4 to SUP 3.0.3. All SUPs and licenses shall be on the USB-C medium you use for downdating. changelog: Adds support for the new camera tracking data output function OpenTrackIO * for Virtual Production
Expands the camera tracking data ( free‑d ) functionality:\n\t
Adds support for the following camera position and orientation offsets:\n\t\t
Offset for the slide‑base scale position
Supports additional name setting characters for the following Web App features:\n\t
PTZ Trace
PTZ Auto‑Framing composition presets
Improves SRT connectivity
Improves operational stability of the camera
*Compliant with SMPTE RIS‑OSVP

The output values for camera position information (X/Y/Z axis offsets) and orientation information (pan/tilt/roll angles) are unified between OpenTrackIO and free‑d . For details, please refer to the Integration Manual for Tracking Data Output .
If the camera is updated while SETUP switch 4 is ON , the IP address will be forcibly fixed and the camera may not be able to connect after the update.
Access the camera from a web browser and update the firmware. For details, please refer to the ILME-FR7 Help Guide .
The camera software update must be performed with the lens removed and the pan/tilt lock unlocked.

install.heading: Step 1: Download the Update File
items: Connect your computer to the internet.
Click the Download button above.
After reading the disclaimer, click Download .\n\t
Save the file to the desktop of your computer (recommended).

install.heading: Step 2: Update the Software
items: Connect the camera and the computer with the saved update file to the same network, and then turn them on.
Display the Web App screen of the camera in a web browser on the computer.\n\t
Select Maintenance -> Information -> Camera , and then check the Model Name and Version Number in the web menu.

Select Maintenance -> Information -> Camera -> Version Up in the web menu, press the Choose File button, and select the update file ( Update_ILMEFR7V400.dat ) that you downloaded. \t \t Note: Do not perform the following actions until the update has been completed:\n\t
Disconnecting the network
Closing the Web App screen (web browser)
The following screen appears: \t \n\t
The update will fail if no update is required. Check the software version of the camera again.
The update file will start uploading. A progress bar will appear during this process. Wait until the uploading is complete before proceeding. \t
When the update file finishes uploading, the Web App screen will appear and the update will start. \t Notes: \n\t
The update process time will vary depending on your network environment.
The POWER lamp will blink yellow during the update process.
When the update process ends, the camera will reboot automatically. This will take a few minutes. Leave the camera turned on and wait until the POWER lamp lights up in green.

install.heading: Prepare the SD card
items: SD card must be 16 GB or smaller.
Format as FAT or FAT32 (Windows) or MS-DOS FAT (macOS). If partitioned, select MBR Master Boot Record under Scheme.

install.heading: Download and copy firmware
items: Visit downloads.smallhd.com and download the latest PageOS firmware.
Extract the .bin file from the .zip download.
Drag and drop the .bin file onto your SD card.

install.heading: Install on the monitor
items: Remove the SD card from your computer.
Insert the SD card into your SmallHD monitor.
Turn on the monitor.
Swipe/toggle left, or tap the screen to access the Settings Menu.
Scroll down and tap FIRMWARE.
Tap the available firmware, then follow the prompts to begin the update.
Once complete, hold the power button for at least 5 seconds to reboot.
Press the power button again to start using the updated firmware.

install.heading: Step 1: Update the System Software
items: Insert the memory card that contains the saved system software data into slot 1 of the camera. For models with two slots, make sure to insert the memory card into slot 1 . Only slot 1 will recognize the system software data.

Y.YY : Newest version number
Do not remove the battery or memory card during the update.

summary: We are pleased to announce the release of ALEXA Mini LF Software Update Package SUP 7.3.2.

install.heading: Update Procedure
items: After downloading the update file from the Software Update Packages for Cameras webpage, double-click the downloaded .zip file to unpack it, or unpack it manually. This will extract two update files to your computer (*.SUP and *.lic)

If not done beforehand, prepare the memory stick for use with the ALEXA Mini LF by connecting it to the Web Remote and press CONFIRM. This will create the required folder structure on the memory stick
Connect the memory stick to your computer. Place the downloaded *.SUP file in the ARRI/A-MINI-LF/SUP folder. Place the downloaded *.lic file in the ARRI/A-MINI-LF/LICENSES folder

The camera Software Update Package includes updates not only for the camera body but also for the MVF-2 viewfinder and the lens mount. Therefore, ensure that the MVF-2 viewfinder and the lens mount are connected to the camera during the update process
Ensure the camera is connected to a power supply or powered by a fully charged battery to prevent power loss during the update
Connect the memory stick to the camera and navigate to the menu item

Select the SUP file from the list and start the installation. The MVF-2 as well as the camera side display will show a screen displaying the update progress. Please note, that the update can take up to 20 minutes. The MVF-2 viewfinder may turn off during the update process and will not provide continuous visual feedback. Do not power off or unplug the camera until it has rebooted. After the update process has finished, a success message is displayed
Ensure that the correct time zone is set in MENU > System > System Time & Date

summary: This Software Update Package is a maintenance release and includes important bug fixes and support for modified hardware parameters. For all ALEXA Mini owners we recommend updating to SUP 6.1.2. We highly recommend that you take your time to go through the Release Notes before you start using the camera.

install.heading: Camera Update Procedure
items: using a Web Browser on your Computer How to connect ALEXA to a computer
Turn the camera on
Connect the Ethernet port of the computer to the camera with the ALEXA Ethernet/RJ-45 Cable
Configure the computer’s network interface to which the camera is connected with the following settings: IP address: 169.254.1.2 (static IP) Subnet mask: 255.255.0.0
Open a web browser

If you are using a Macintosh or a computer with Apple’s Bonjour protocol installed enter the following URL into the address bar: http://alexaXXXX.local/update.cgi, where XXXX is the four-digit serial number of your camera (e.g. for

If you are using a computer without Bonjour support please use the camera’s IP address to connect, e.g.: http://169.254.xxx.xxx/update.cgi, where xxx.xxx is the two last groups of your camera’s actual IP address. You can determine ALEXA’s IP address by going to INFO > SYSTEM
If the network settings are configured correctly you will be presented the update page of the camera. Performing the Update
Download the Software Update Package to your computer
Perform a factory reset in MENU > USER SETUPS > FACTORY RESET
In the ‘Camera Update’ section select the Software Update Package by clicking the ‘browse’ button and selecting the path to the downloaded SUP on your computer
Click the 'Update Camera’ button in the ‘Camera Update’ section

The file will be uploaded to the camera which takes about a minute. The browser will switch to the ‘Update Log’ page showing the update log of the three main boards. This page can be updated by refreshing the page. At the same time the update screen with the progress bars appears on the camera display

The update process may take 15 to 20 minutes, depending on the actual software package. Wait until the update process has finished. This is indicated by a green screen informing you that the update process is completed
If the update process fails, which will be indicated by a red screen, please restart the camera and repeat the update procedure

After the update, turn the camera off and on again. The software is now updated, and you can use the camera. Updating an Electronic Viewfinder EVF-1 or EVF-2 In case an ALEXA electronic viewfinder EVF-1 or EVF-2 has not been updated with the camera, it is possible to update the viewfinder separately by using a computer. Please note that the viewfinder will be updated to match the SUP package that is installed on the camera
Connect the Ethernet port of the computer as described above in ‘How to connect ALEXA to a computer’
Connect the viewfinder to the camera
Open a web browser on the computer and open the update web page of the camera (see above)
Click the 'Update EVF' button in the ‘EVF Update’ section
You can watch the progress of the update on the screen

When the update is done, the last line on the screen reads ‘successfully updated Evf’. The update is now finished even though the web browser continues to refresh the page. This is normal. The viewfinder is up to date
Depending on its software version, the camera may state: ‘software error – reboot camera’ on the camera display. This is normal. Please reboot the camera
